# Lizard Lizard Lizard

> A free browser-based lizard clicker game. Click the lizard, hear the lizard, beat your high score.

Lizard Lizard Lizard (lizardlizard.ai) is a single-page clicker game featuring Tom the Lizard. Every click plays a sound and increases a click counter; the all-time high score is saved locally in the visitor's browser. The game is free, has no ads, no sign-up, and no tracking.

## Key facts
- Game type: one-button clicker game
- Character: Tom the Lizard
- Cost: free, no sign-up required
- Platform: works in any modern browser, desktop and mobile
- Data: high score stored in browser localStorage only, not transmitted anywhere

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://lizardlizard.ai/): the game itself, plus About, How to Play, Features, FAQ, and Credits sections
